overview: The Medford City Council met to address community concerns regarding zoning governance, public notification for the MBTA Green Line Extension, and traffic safety across the city. The council also considered an appropriation for the Brooks Estate Carriage House and tabled a public hearing on an Eversource transmission line project.

items.title: Public Participation: ZBA Decisions and Tufts Student Housing
items.summary: Resident Cheryl Rodriguez raised concerns about Zoning Board of Appeals decisions and local zoning compliance, while Ken Krause outlined Tufts University's plans to convert 13 properties into upper-level student housing.

items.title: Green Line Extension Public Notification and Community Impact
items.summary: Residents criticized MassDOT's lack of abutter notification regarding a recent Green Line Extension meeting, leading the council to vote to request an extended MBTA comment period, a city public meeting, and notification to the state delegation.

items.title: Public Hearing: Eversource 115 kV Transmission Line Project
items.summary: The council opened a public hearing regarding Eversource's proposed 115 kV underground transmission line from Woburn to Mystic Station and voted to table the matter to December 5.

items.title: Chamber of Commerce Executive Director and Mustang Football Recognitions
items.summary: The council passed resolutions welcoming Maria Ferretra as the new Executive Director of the Medford Chamber of Commerce and wishing the Medford High School Mustang football team success in their Thanksgiving Day game.

items.title: Routine Traffic and Infrastructure Maintenance Motions
items.summary: The council approved resolutions for turn restrictions on Elm and Yale Streets, stop lines at Water and Fulton Streets, road divot repairs on Windsor Road, sidewalk repairs on Bonner Avenue, pothole repairs on Commercial Street, and traffic signal timing adjustments on Forest Street.

items.title: Updates on Police Station Construction and Fire Training Tower
items.summary: The council approved a resolution requesting written periodic updates on the planning and construction timeline for the new police station and an update from the fire training tower search committee.

items.title: Bustle Road Staging Area, Land Ownership, and Traffic Concerns
items.summary: The council passed resolutions requesting the city solicitor determine land ownership along Bustle Road, asking contractors to clean up the staging area following the Grove Street water main project, and requesting an electronic speed sign.

items.title: Brooks Estate Carriage House Stabilization Funding
items.summary: A mayoral request to appropriate $200,000 from free cash for structural stabilization of the Brooks Estate Carriage House was tabled for one week after Councilor Lungo-Koehn invoked Rule 20.

items.title: Oakland Street Traffic Safety Report Request
items.summary: The council passed a resolution requesting a report from the Police Chief and Traffic Commission regarding cut-through traffic and potential one-way options on Oakland Street.

items.title: Lawrence Memorial Hospital Deed Restrictions Inquiry
items.summary: The council approved a resolution requesting that the city administration report whether any deed restrictions exist on the Lawrence Memorial Hospital parcel.

items.title: Wildwood Road Staging Area Repair Status
items.summary: The council passed a resolution asking the DPW Commissioner for a status update on repairing road and lawn depressions caused by a previous staging area at 31 Wildwood Road.
